sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: SYNOPTIC PATTERN WILL UNDERGO FURTHER AMPLIFICATION FRIDAY WITH A RIDGE BUILDING OVER THE WRN STATES AND UPPER LOW DEEPENING IN THE EAST. SEVERAL SMALLER SCALE VORTICITY MAXIMA WILL MIGRATE THROUGH THE ERN U.S. UPPER LOW. A COLD FRONT WILL ADVANCE SWD THROUGH THE SRN PLAINS...LOWER MS AND TN VALLEYS WITHIN THE AMPLIFYING NWLY FLOW REGIME. FARTHER EAST AN AREA OF LOW PRESSURE WILL PERSIST OVER THE OH VALLEY AND NERN STATES WITH A LEE TROUGH EXTENDING SWD THROUGH THE MID ATLANTIC AND CAROLINAS.

sections.title: LOWER MS VALLEY INTO SERN STATES
sections.text: RICH LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE WITH LOW-MID 70S DEWPOINTS WILL PERSIST IN PRE-FRONTAL WARM SECTOR AND SUPPORT 2000-2500 J/KG MLCAPE AS THE SFC LAYER WARMS. STORMS MAY BE ONGOING BY 12Z FRIDAY FROM AR TO WRN TN WITHIN ZONE OF LOW-LEVEL WARM ADVECTION...POSING A MODEST SEVERE THREAT. OTHER STORMS MAY DEVELOP ALONG RESIDUAL OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES FROM MORNING CONVECTION AND IN WARM SECTOR AS THE ATMOSPHERE DESTABILIZES. MUCH OF THIS REGION WILL RESIDE WITHIN BELT OF MODERATE NWLY-WNWLY WINDS ALOFT WITH MODEST NWLY /20-30 KT/ UNIDIRECTIONAL EFFECTIVE SHEAR. THIS ENVIRONMENT WILL FAVOR SEWD MOVING MULTICELLS AND STORM CLUSTERS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND HAIL THROUGH EARLY EVENING.

sections.title: ERN PORTIONS OF OH VALLEY...MID ATLANTIC THROUGH NERN STATES
sections.text: WSWLY WINDS ALOFT WILL STRENGTHEN AS A RESULT OF THE AMPLIFYING UPPER TROUGH. UPPER 60S TO NEAR 70 DEWPOINTS WILL EXIST EAST OF LEE TROUGH SUPPORTING MODERATE /1000-2000 J/KG/ MLCAPE AS THE SFC LAYER WARMS DURING THE AFTERNOON. STORMS WILL ONCE AGAIN DEVELOP BY LATE MORNING INTO THE AFTERNOON OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN AND IN LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE ZONE AND SPREAD INTO THE DESTABILIZING WARM SECTOR. OTHER STORMS WILL INITIATE WITHIN THE WEAKLY CAPPED ENVIRONMENT OVER THE OH VALLEY. VERTICAL SHEAR INCREASING TO 30-40 KT WILL SUPPORT POSSIBILITY OF ORGANIZED STORMS INCLUDING POTENTIAL FOR BOWING LINE SEGMENTS AND UPDRAFT ROTATION. ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND AND LARGE HAIL WILL BE THE MAIN THREATS INTO EARLY EVENING.

sections.title: CNTRL ROCKIES AND HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: A FEW STORMS WILL PROBABLY DEVELOP OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF THE CNTRL ROCKIES AND MOVE INTO A WEAK UPSLOPE FLOW REGIME OVER THE CNTRL HIGH PLAINS. STEEP LAPSE RATES AND LOW-LEVEL DEWPOINTS IN THE 40S TO NEAR 50 WILL SUPPORT 500-1000 J/KG MLCAPE. LARGE TEMPERATURE-DEWPOINT SPREADS INDICATE POTENTIAL FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND GUSTS WITH THIS HIGH BASED ACTIVITY. AT THIS TIME...IT APPEARS COVERAGE OF ANY SEVERE EVENTS WILL REMAIN SPARSE. ..DIAL/LEITMAN.. 06/28/2013

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: FURTHER AMPLIFICATION IS EXPECTED OVER THE CONUS THIS PERIOD AS GRT BASIN RIDGE BUILDS N INTO THE CANADIAN RCKYS...AND GRT LKS TROUGH EVOLVES INTO A CLOSED LOW OVER SE ONT. A SERIES OF DISTURBANCES NOW OVER THE CANADIAN PRAIRIE PROVINCES AND THE UPR MS VLY WILL CONTINUE SE INTO THE MIDWEST/OH VLY. AT THE SFC...A COLD FRONT WILL ADVANCE S/SE ACROSS THE SRN PLNS AND THE LWR MS...LWR TN...AND OH VLYS...WHILE DIFFUSE LOW RETROGRESSES N/W FROM UPSTATE NY INTO SRN ONT/SW QUE. GIVEN THIS PATTERN...LEE TROUGH SHOULD PERSIST FROM NJ SW INTO WRN CAROLINAS. SCTD TSTMS AND TSTM CLUSTERS WILL PRECEDE AND ACCOMPANY THE COLD FRONT. SOME OF THE STORMS WILL BE SVR...ESPECIALLY THIS AFTN INTO TNGT.

sections.title: ERN OH VLY TO CAROLINAS/MID-ATLANTIC/NORTHEAST THIS AFTN/EVE
sections.text: DEEP...MODERATE W TO WSW MID-LVL FLOW WILL PREVAIL OVER MUCH OF THE EAST TODAY...ON DOWNSTREAM SIDE OF AMPLIFYING UPR TROUGH. SFC DEWPOINTS WILL REMAIN IN THE 60S TO NEAR 70 F...ESPECIALLY ALONG LEE TROUGH. SATELLITE SUGGESTS THAT SFC HEATING WILL BE STRONG IN MOST AREAS. GIVEN RELATIVELY COOL MID-LVL TEMPS AND ABSENCE OF APPRECIABLE CIN...SETUP SHOULD YIELD FAIRLY WIDESPREAD COVERAGE OF DIURNALLY-ENHANCED STORMS...ESPECIALLY BY EARLY AFTN FROM VA/WV NEWD INTO ERN PA/NJ/SE NY/CT...AND A BIT LATER IN THE DAY OVER THE WRN/CNTRL CAROLINAS. STORMS INITIALLY MAY FOCUS DOWNSTREAM FROM UPR DISTURBANCES NOW MOVING TOWARD OH/PA/WV...AND A BIT OVER THE SRN APPALACHIANS AND LEE TROUGH. 30-40 KT W TO WSWLY DEEP SHEAR SHOULD PROMOTE STORM SUSTENANCE/ORGANIZATION. ASSOCIATED LINES...BOWING SEGMENTS...AND ROTATING MID-LVL CORES COULD POSE A RISK FOR DMGG WIND GUSTS AND SVR HAIL THROUGH EARLY TNGT.

sections.title: LWR MS VLY/SOUTHEAST TODAY/TNGT
sections.text: MODERATE TO STRONG SFC HEATING OF RICHLY-MOIST LOW-LVL ENVIRONMENT ACROSS THE LWR MS VLY/GULF CST STATES TODAY WILL YIELD 2000-2500 J/KG MLCAPE. ONGOING...PRE-FRONTAL MCS NOW OVER NRN MS SHOULD CONTINUE SSE. GIVEN EXPECTED DIURNAL DESTABILIZATION...SOME REJUVENATION OF THE SYSTEM...OR REDEVELOPMENT ALONG ITS PERIPHERY...SEEMS LIKELY DESPITE DECREASE IN DEEP SHEAR WITH SWD EXTENT. THE MAIN SVR THREAT SHOULD BE LOCALLY DMGG WIND. OTHER STRONG TO SVR STORMS MAY FORM ALONG COLD FRONT OVER THE TN VLY...AND ALONG OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES LEFT BY OVERNIGHT STORMS IN THE FL PANHANDLE AND SRN AL/GA. MODEST /25-30 KT/...DIFFLUENT MID/UPR-LVL N TO NW FLOW MAY PROMOTE S OR SE-MOVING MULTICELLS/STORM CLUSTERS CAPABLE OF ISOLD DMGG WIND AND MARGINALLY SVR HAIL THROUGH EARLY TNGT.

sections.title: CNTRL RCKYS/HIGH PLNS THIS AFTN/EVE
sections.text: WDLY SCTD TO SCTD AFTN/EVE STORMS ARE EXPECTED OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF THE CNTRL RCKYS. THEY SHOULD MOVE E/SE INTO WEAK UPSLOPE FLOW OVER THE CNTRL HIGH PLNS BY EVE. STEEP LOW TO MID-LVL LAPSE RATES WITH SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE UPR 40S F WILL HELP BOOST SBCAPE TO NEAR 1000 J/KG. WHILE THE LARGE TEMP-DEWPOINT SPREADS COULD YIELD ISOLD DMGG WIND GUSTS AND ALLOW FOR COLD POOL AMALGAMATION/DEVELOPMENT OF SMALL STORM CLUSTERS ...WEAK CLOUD-LAYER SHEAR AND LOW-LVL FLOW SHOULD LIMIT DEGREE/EXTENT OF THE SVR THREAT. ..CORFIDI/MOSIER.. 06/28/2013

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: INTENSIFICATION OF A MID/UPPER-LEVEL LOW OVER THE GREAT LAKES/SWRN ONTARIO WILL CONTRIBUTE TO THE AMPLIFICATION OF THE LARGE-SCALE PATTERN THROUGH THE D1 PERIOD. A BELT OF ENHANCED MIDLEVEL FLOW WILL BE MAINTAINED BETWEEN THIS LOW AND THE WRN U.S. ANTICYCLONE FROM THE NRN PLAINS THROUGH THE OH VALLEY TO MID-ATLANTIC COAST AND NEW ENGLAND. A SERIES OF LOW-AMPLITUDE PERTURBATIONS WILL PROGRESS THROUGH THIS HIGH-MOMENTUM AIR STREAM...AUGMENTING CONVECTIVE POTENTIAL FROM PARTS OF THE UPPER-OH VALLEY TO MID-ATLANTIC COAST AND SRN NEW ENGLAND. IN THE LOW LEVELS...MID-MORNING SFC ANALYSIS REVEALED THE PRESENCE OF A COUPLE OF SYNOPTIC BOUNDARIES...ONE EXTENDING FROM LOW PRESSURE OVER THE UPPER-HUDSON VALLEY SWWD THROUGH THE MID-SOUTH INTO SRN PLAINS. THE OTHER STRETCHED FROM LOW PRESSURE OVER SWRN ONTARIO WSWWD TO A LEE LOW OVER NERN CO. EXPECT AT LEAST THE ERN EXTENSIONS OF BOTH BOUNDARIES TO CONTINUE SEWD WITHIN PREVAILING NWLY MIDLEVEL FLOW REGIME. ...UPPER-OH VALLEY EWD INTO NEW ENGLAND...THE MID-ATLANTIC STATES AND CAROLINAS THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING... 12Z OBSERVED SOUNDINGS AND SATELLITE-DERIVED PW IMAGERY INDICATE A VERY MOIST AIR MASS PRESENT E OF THE APPALACHIANS AND AHEAD OF TH

sections.title: CNTRL HIGH PLAINS THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING
sections.text: THE PRESENCE OF THE LEE LOW AND WEAKER SECONDARY FRONT WILL ENHANCE UPSLOPE FLOW FROM THE CHEYENNE RIDGE SWD INTO N-CNTRL/NERN CO...BENEATH THE WRN FRINGE OF STRONGER NWLY FLOW ALOFT. THOUGH LARGE-SCALE FORCING FOR ASCENT WILL REMAIN NEGLIGIBLE THROUGH THE PEAK OF THE DIURNAL HEATING CYCLE...ISOLATED TSTMS ARE EXPECTED TO FORM OVER THE HIGH TERRAIN AND SUBSEQUENTLY MOVE SEWD. GIVEN STEEP LAPSE RATES...MLCAPE OF 1000-1500 J/KG...AND MODESTLY STRONG DEEP NWLY SHEAR...THE SETUP WILL BE SUPPORTIVE OF SUSTAINED/ROTATING STORMS CAPABLE OF HAIL AND LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS. EXPECTED STORM COVERAGE PRECLUDES AN UPGRADE TO SLIGHT RISK AT THIS JUNCTURE. ..MEAD/COHEN.. 06/28/2013

sections.title: DISCUSSION
sections.text: ONLY MINOR TWEAKS TO THE CURRENT FORECAST ARE BEING MADE ATTM...REFLECTIVE OF THE LATEST CONVECTIVE TRENDS. OTHERWISE...THE SITUATION CONTINUES TO EVOLVE AS EXPECTED...WITH WIDESPREAD CONVECTION E OF THE MS RIVER -- INCLUDING ONGOING SEVERE POTENTIAL MAINLY CONFINED TO THE ATLANTIC AND GULF COAST STATES. ISOLATED SEVERE POTENTIAL IS ALSO FORECAST TO EVOLVE THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING ACROSS THE HIGH PLAINS INVOF ERN CO...AS MODEST DESTABILIZATION ON THE WRN FRINGE OF THE STRONGER BELT OF UPPER NWLYS SUPPORTS LOCAL HAIL/WIND POTENTIAL. ..GOSS.. 06/28/2013 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1114 AM CDT FRI JUN 28 2013/

mesoscale_discussions.summary: REMAINDER WW MAY BE ALLOWED TO EXPIRE AS SCHEDULED. HOWEVER...SVR THREAT MAY REDEVELOP THIS MORNING INTO AFTN ACROSS PORTIONS MS/AL FARTHER S...ALONG AND S OF BOUNDARY FROM DECAYING MCS. IN THAT EVENT...ANOTHER WW MAY BE REQUIRED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MCS RESPONSIBLE FOR MEASURED SIGNIFICANT-SVR GUSTS IN EXTREME NERN AR AT 1014Z CONTINUES TO WEAKEN ACROSS NRN MS AS GUST FRONT AND RELATED BAND OF GRAVITY WAVES SURGES AHEAD OF REMAINING RADAR REFLECTIVITIES AND LEADING PART OF OUTFLOW POOL BECOMES SHALLOW. SPORADIC TSTMS CONTINUE TO DEVELOP BEHIND SFC GUST FRONT AND ALONG GRAVITY WAVES...CONTRIBUTING TO ENOUGH MAINTENANCE OF COLD POOL TO KEEP COMBINED BOUNDARY PROGRESSIVE FOR NOW. HOWEVER...THIS BOUNDARY MAY DECELERATE/STALL ACROSS PORTIONS CENTRAL MS...ERN AR AND NWRN AL...REINFORCED BY DIFFERENTIAL DIABATIC HEATING AS STG INSOLATION DESTABILIZES FOREGOING BOUNDARY LAYER. WITH SFC DEW POINTS 70S F...ANTECEDENT MLCINH SHOULD ERODE RAPIDLY AND MLCAPE WILL INCREASE PAST 3000 J/KG. WEAK LOW-LEVEL WINDS AND LACK OF VERTICAL SHEAR SHOULD LIMIT ORGANIZATION OF ADDITIONAL CONVECTION THAT DEVELOPS...UNTIL AND UNLESS ANY SUBSTANTIAL NEW COLD POOL FORMS TO AID IN FORCED ASCENT AND FORWARD PROPAGATION OF ANY NEW MCS. MEANWHILE...TRAILING CONVECTION OVER TOP OF COLD POOL...ACROSS PORTIONS ST FRANCIS COUNTY AR AS OF 1615Z...APPEARS TO BE JUST NE OF TRAILING PORTION OF GUST FRONT. THESE TSTMS MAY PRODUCE STG GUSTS AND HAIL APCHG SVR LIMITS...AND WILL BE MONITORED FOR POSSIBILITY OF INTENSIFICATION AND UPSCALE GROWTH IF THEY CAN BE SUSTAINED INTO FAVORABLY UNSTABLE PRE-OUTFLOW SECTOR FARTHER SE. ..EDWARDS.. 06/28/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: WIDELY SCATTERED TSTMS...NEAR AND WITHIN BAND OF INITIALLY NON-SVR CONVECTION OVER DISCUSSION AREA -- MAY STRENGTHEN TO NEAR SVR LEVELS THROUGH MID-AFTN. ISOLATED DAMAGING GUSTS OR BRIEF TORNADO CANNOT BE RULED OUT. HOWEVER...POTENTIAL CURRENTLY APPEARS TOO LOW-END...CONDITIONAL AND LIMITED IN AREA FOR WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: 16Z SFC MESOANALYSIS SHOWS PRE-FRONTAL CONFLUENCE LINE FROM WARM-FRONTAL INTERSECTION NEAR VT/NH BORDER SWD NEAR CT/VT/NH JUNCTION SSWWD ACROSS CT TO NYC AREA. THIS FEATURE REPRESENTS WIND SHIFT BETWEEN RELATIVELY VEERED/SSWLY-SWLY FLOW OVER LOWER HUDSON REGION TO SSWLY/SLY FLOW OVER SERN NEW ENGLAND. BAND OF CONVECTION HAS PERSISTED INVOF THIS BOUNDARY OVER CT...EXTENDING OFF BOUNDARY INTO CENTRAL MA...WHILE ADDITIONAL/ISOLATED ACTIVITY HAS FORMED ALONG BOUNDARY NEAR SW CORNER OF NH. AIR MASS IS DESTABILIZING FAVORABLY ON BOTH SIDES OF BOUNDARY AMIDST CLOUD BREAKS AND SFC INSOLATION. HOWEVER...GREATEST BOUNDARY-LAYER MOISTURE AND LOW-LEVEL SHEAR ARE EVIDENT E OF BOUNDARY ACROSS ERN CT...CENTRAL-ERN MA AND RI...AND W OF RELATIVELY COOL/STABLE ATLC MARINE LAYER. ACCORDINGLY MODIFIED RAOBS AND FCST SOUNDINGS SHOW WEAK MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES OFFSET ENOUGH BY SFC HEATING TO YIELD 500-1000 J/KG MLCAPE...AND POCKET OF 100-200 J/KG 0-3 KM CAPE IS EVIDENT JUST AHEAD OF CONVECTIVE BAND OVER ERN CT AND E-CENTRAL MA. ERN FRINGES OF SUBTLE DCVA/DESTABILIZATION ALOFT...RELATED SMALL SHORTWAVE THAT IS EVIDENT IN MOISTURE CHANNEL IMAGERY PIVOTING NEWD ACROSS CENTRAL-ERN PA...ALSO MAY SUPPORT NEW ENGLAND TSTM ENVIRONMENT. PERTURBATION ALOFT ALSO MAY MAINTAIN MID-UPPER GRADIENT FLOW ENOUGH TO MAINTAIN MRGL EFFECTIVE SHEAR MAGNITUDES 30-35 KT. QUASI-LINEAR STRUCTURE ALREADY EVIDENT IN PRIMARY CONVECTIVE BAND APPEARS TO REDUCE POTENTIAL FOR SUSTAINED/DISCRETE SUPERCELL STRUCTURES...AS DOES LACK OF MORE ROBUST DEEP SHEAR...BUT SHORT-LIVED/STORM-SCALE ROTATION MAY OCCUR. ADDITIONAL TSTMS MAY DEVELOP OVER PORTIONS SERN NY AND WRN CT...MOVING EWD INTO THIS AREA BEHIND INITIAL BAND. THOUGH SUCH ACTIVITY WOULD BE IN WEAKER VERTICAL SHEAR THAN FARTHER E...ISOLATED HAIL AND GUSTS APCHG SVR LIMITS A

mesoscale_discussions.summary: WW IS REQUIRED FOR PORTIONS SRN PA...MD...NRN VA AND WV...AND ANOTHER WW IS POSSIBLE ELSEWHERE ACROSS BROADER DISCUSSION AREA AS TRENDS INDICATE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: BROAD AREA OF TSTMS HAS BEEN GRADUALLY BUILDING FROM SERN LOWER MI EWD ACROSS UPPER OH VALLEY REGION AND INTO N-CENTRAL APPALACHIANS. INITIALLY WIDELY SCATTERED COVERAGE SHOULD BECOME MORE DENSE...AND CONVECTION MORE INTENSE...WHILE MOVING INTO INCREASINGLY UNSTABLE BOUNDARY LAYER. MAIN CONCERN IS DAMAGING WIND...WITH OCNL HAIL ALSO POSSIBLE. CONVECTION HAS FORMED IN DECREASINGLY CAPPED AIR MASS...ON BOTH SIDES OF ILL-DEFINED FRONTAL ZONE EXTENDING SWWD FROM SFC LOW OVER UPPER HUDSON RIVER REGION. SFC DEW POINTS GENERALLY 60S F...BUT INCREASING TO NEAR 70 AROUND CHESAPEAKE BAY AND DE VALLEY REGIONS...COMBINE WITH SFC DIABATIC HEATING OF PRECONVECTIVE AIR MASS TO YIELD 1000-1500 J/KG MLCAPE IN MODIFIED RAOBS AND FCST SOUNDINGS. KINEMATIC PROFILES ARE MOSTLY WLY AND NEARLY UNIDIRECTIONAL...INDICATING PREDOMINANT QUASI-LINEAR EVOLUTION WITH DAMAGING GUSTS BEING GREATEST CONCERN. DEEP SHEAR INCREASES WITH SWD EXTENT FROM UPPER GREAT LAKES INTO PORTIONS WV AND NRN VA...WITH EFFECTIVE SHEAR MAGNITUDES PEAKING AROUND 50 KT OVER LATTER AREAS. MOST PROBABLE AREA FOR UPSCALE ORGANIZATION/GROWTH APPEARS TO BE ON NRN FRINGES OF STRONGER SHEAR BELT...WHERE TSTMS HAVE COALESCED ACROSS PORTIONS SERN OH...NRN WV PANHANDLE AND SWRN PA. ANY SUCH EVOLUTION WOULD DRIVE FORWARD-PROPAGATING MCS EWD TO ESEWD ASTRIDE PA/MD BORDER REGION...EVENTUALLY WITH POTENTIAL TO AFFECT CHESAPEAKE BAY/DE RIVER REGIONS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE ARKLAMISS REGION IS BEING MONITORED FOR AN INCREASING POTENTIAL FOR SEVERE THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT THIS AFTERNOON...WITH DMGG WINDS AND LARGE HAIL POSSIBLE. THE ISSUANCE OF A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH IS POSSIBLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RECENT VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGES DEPICT A SWELLING BOUNDARY-LAYER CUMULUS FIELD IN CNTRL/E-CNTRL AR...WITH THIS FIELD SLOWLY SHIFTING SSEWD. THIS ALIGNS WITH THE INTERSECTION OF A WEAK SYNOPTIC FRONTAL SEGMENT ARCING FROM NERN AR INTO W-CNTRL AR...AND A REMNANT OUTFLOW BOUNDARY FROM MORNING CONVECTION THAT JOINS THE SYNOPTIC FRONT NEAR WHITE COUNTY AR AND EXTENDS SEWD TO NEAR GREENWOOD MS TO JUST N OF MERIDIAN MS AND INTO CNTRL AL. VERY STRONG TO LOCALLY EXTREME INSTABILITY EXISTS ACROSS THE AREA AS OF EARLY AFTERNOON...OWING TO INSOLATION AMIDST LOWEST-100-MB MEAN MIXING RATIOS OF 16-18 G/KG LYING BENEATH OF A PLUME OF STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES -- I.E. AROUND 7.0-7.5 C/KM PER JACKSON MS...LITTLE ROCK AR...AND SHREVEPORT LA 12Z RAOBS. CAPPING ACCOMPANYING RELATIVELY WARMER AIR AT THE BASE OF THIS STEEP LAPSE RATE PLUME MAY DELAY THE ONSET OF CONVECTION TO SOME EXTENT...AND KEEP SFC-BASED CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT CONFINED TO THE SWD-MOVING SYNOPTIC FRONT. HOWEVER...MODIFICATIONS TO THE 12Z LZK RAOB TO ACCOUNT FOR CURRENT SFC CONDITIONS INVOF THE CUMULUS FIELD INDICATE AROUND 4000-4500 J/KG OF MLCAPE WITH MLCINH NOW BELOW 30 J/KG. ONE OR TWO MORE HOURS OF DIABATIC SFC HEATING MAY BE SUFFICIENT FOR THE CAP TO BE BREACHED -- MORE LIKELY AFTER 1830Z. ENHANCED LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE INVOF THE INTERSECTION POINT BETWEEN THE FRONT AND OUTFLOW BOUNDARY MAY SERVE AS THE FOCUS FOR INITIAL SFC-BASED CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT DURING THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS OR SO. ADDITIONAL STORM DEVELOPMENT WILL BE POSSIBLE FARTHER W ALONG THE FRONT LATER IN THE DAY AS DIABATIC HEATING YIELDS ADDITIONAL WEAKENING OF THE CAP. EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR VECTORS -- WITH MAGNITUDES INCREASING TO AROUND 20-25 KT -- POSSESSING AT LEAST SOME FRONT-ORTHOGONAL COMPONENT MAY ALLOW CLUSTERS OF STORMS TO FORWARD PROPAGA

REF SPC MESOSCALE DISCUSSION 1285 AND WW 386 FOR AREAS FARTHER E.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SWATH OF DEEP-TROPOSPHERIC CYCLONIC FLOW OVERLIES AT LEAST MRGLLY FAVORABLE LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE ACROSS THIS REGION...WHERE COMBINATION OF SFC DIABATIC HEATING AND DEW POINTS MAINLY 60S F YIELDS MLCAPE 500-1500 J/KG IN MODIFIED RAOBS AND FCST SOUNDINGS. BUOYANCY AND MOISTURE EACH DIMINISH GRADUALLY WITH WWD EXTENT AND SHOULD CONTINUE TO DO SO. LOW-LEVEL SHEAR WILL REMAIN LIMITED BY SUBSTANTIAL WLY COMPONENT OF SFC FLOW...WHILE DEEP SHEAR INCREASES WITH SWD EXTENT IN PROXIMITY TO BELT OF PEAK MID-UPPER WINDS EXTENDING FROM IA ESEWD ACROSS CENTRAL INDIANA TO SWRN OH. THOUGH LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE IS WEAK...SOME CONFLUENCE IS EVIDENT IN STREAMLINES...AND LACK OF MLCINH WILL SUPPORT POTENTIAL FOR ISOLATED TO WIDELY SCATTERED TSTMS OUTSIDE EXISTING AREAS OF CONVECTION. MAIN LIMITING FACTORS ARE POORLY FOCUSED LOW-LEVEL LIFT AND LACK OF MORE ROBUST BUOYANCY. STILL...STRONGEST/MOST SUSTAINED CELLS MAY PRODUCE DAMAGING GUSTS AND MRGLLY SVR HAIL.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTMS ARE EXPECTED TO INCREASE IN COVERAGE AND INTENSITY THIS AFTERNOON WITH A RISK FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND SOME HAIL. A WW IS POSSIBLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST TRENDS IN VISIBLE SATELLITE AND RADAR DATA INDICATE DEVELOPING TSTMS OVER THE HIGH TERRAIN OF FAR WRN VA AND ADDITIONAL DEEPENING CUMULUS SWD INTO WRN NC. THE DOWNSTREAM AIR MASS E OF THE BLUE RIDGE IS RATHER MOIST WITH DEWPOINTS IN THE UPPER 60S TO LOWER 70S. AND WHILE MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES ARE POOR...STRONG DAYTIME HEATING IS CONTRIBUTING TO A MODERATELY UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT WITH MLCAPE VALUES OF AROUND 2000 J/KG. HEATING ALONG THE HIGH TERRAIN AND CONVERGENCE ALONG A DEVELOPING LEE TROUGH ARE EXPECTED TO PROMOTE AN INCREASE IN STORM COVERAGE AND VIGOR THROUGH THE AFTERNOON. THIS ACTIVITY WILL EVOLVE WITHIN A KINEMATIC ENVIRONMENT FEATURING A LARGELY UNIDIRECTIONAL WIND PROFILE WITH 35-40 KT FLOW IN THE 2-6-KM AGL LAYER /PER FCX AND MRX VAD DATA/. AS SUCH...THE POTENTIAL WILL EXIST FOR UPSCALE STORM DEVELOPMENT INTO A FORWARD-PROPAGATING LINE WHICH IS IN GOOD AGREEMENT WITH RECENT CONVECTION-ALLOWING MODEL FORECASTS. DAMAGING WINDS WOULD BE THE PRIMARY HAZARD SHOULD SUCH A SCENARIO UNFOLD. ..MEAD.. 06/28/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE THREAT FOR DMGG WINDS AND POTENTIALLY MARGINALLY SVR HAIL CONTINUES ACROSS WW 385.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CONVECTIVE REGENERATION ALONG AN OUTFLOW BOUNDARY ATTENDANT TO MORNING CONVECTION HAS GIVEN WAY TO MULTICELL CONVECTIVE CLUSTERS ACROSS PARTS OF CNTRL AL. THE MOST INTENSE CLUSTERS WILL CONTINUE TO ADVANCE SEWD AT AROUND 25-30 KT ACROSS PARTS OF S-CNTRL AND SERN AL DURING THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO. THESE STORMS WILL POSE A POTENTIAL FOR DMGG WIND GUSTS AND PERHAPS MARGINALLY SVR HAIL...GIVEN 3500-5000 J/KG OF UNINHIBITED MLCAPE CHARACTERIZING INFLOW BUOYANCY FOR DEVELOPING UPDRAFTS. WATER LOADING WITH HIGH PW WILL BOLSTER DOWNDRAFT STRENGTH. WITHIN A SIMILAR ENVIRONMENT...ADDITIONAL SEVERE STORM DEVELOPMENT WILL BE OF CONCERN DURING THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO FARTHER S TOWARD THE GULF COAST INVOF SEA BREEZE CONVERGENCE ZONES...ALONG THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY INTO W-CNTRL GA...AND ALONG DIFFERENTIAL HEATING ZONES INTO SWRN GA AND SERN AL. AREAS FARTHER W INTO PARTS OF E-CNTRL MS MAY BE FREE OF DEEP CONVECTION DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS...BUT ADDITIONAL STORM DEVELOPMENT UPSTREAM ACROSS THE ARKLAMISS REGION MAY AFFECT THESE AREAS LATER TODAY...AS ADDRESSED IN MESOSCALE DISCUSSION NUMBER 1286. ..COHEN.. 06/28/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A FEW STORMS MAY PRODUCE DMGG WIND GUSTS INTO THE AFTERNOON HOURS...BUT THE ISSUANCE OF A WW IS UNLIKELY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A NWD-MOVING OUTFLOW BOUNDARY OVER SERN GA IS PRECEDED BY STRONG INSTABILITY...WHICH WILL FOSTER REGENERATIVE CONVECTION NWD INTO PARTS OF SERN GA WHILE STRONG STORMS SUCCEED THE BOUNDARY. WITH STEEPENING LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES OUTSIDE OF CONVECTIVELY OVERTURNED AIR...STRONG DOWNDRAFTS WILL BE LIKELY. DOWNWARD MASS TRANSPORT WILL BE ACCELERATED BY SUBSTANTIAL PRECIPITATION LOADING OWING TO PW VALUES OF 1.8-2.0 INCHES PER GPS DATA. ISOLATED DMGG WIND GUSTS CANNOT BE RULED OUT THROUGH THE AFTERNOON...THOUGH WEAK DEEP SHEAR WILL GREATLY LIMIT CONVECTIVE ORGANIZATION.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A POTENTIAL FOR ISOLATED SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WILL EXIST THROUGH THE AFTERNOON HOURS...AND THE ISSUANCE OF A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH IS POSSIBLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A WEAK OUTFLOW BOUNDARY ACCOMPANYING MORNING CONVECTION HAS MOVED INTO NWRN AND W-CNTRL GA AND ARCS WSWWD INTO CNTRL/SRN AL. THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT HAS BEEN NOTED ACROSS PARTS OF W-CNTRL GA INVOF THE BOUNDARY AND TO ITS EAST WITHIN A MOIST/LARGELY UNCAPPED ENVIRONMENT. THIS ACTIVITY MAY HAVE A TENDENCY TO SPREAD EWD/SEWD ACROSS PARTS OF CNTRL/ERN GA AND INTO WRN SC WHERE MLCAPE VALUES OF 1500-3000 J/KG EXIST OWING TO STRONG DIURNAL HEATING AMIDST A RELATIVELY MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER. HOWEVER...GPS PW DATA INDICATE A CORRIDOR OF RELATIVELY LOWER PW EXTENDING FROM THE CNTRL APPALACHIANS INTO CNTRL GA -- PERHAPS ASSOCIATED WITH A POCKET OF SUBSIDENT MID-LEVEL FLOW ON THE BACKSIDE OF AN ERN CONUS CYCLONE. SFC OBS INDICATE DEWPOINTS MIXING OUT INTO THE MIDDLE 60S BENEATH THIS LOWER-PW CORRIDOR...CONTRIBUTING TO RELATIVELY SMALLER MLCAPE BUT LARGER SFC TEMPERATURE-DEWPOINT SPREADS. THE NET RESULT MAY BE FOR ONLY SPORADIC PULSE CONVECTIVE COVERAGE AMIDST WEAK VERTICAL SHEAR PER VWP DATA...THOUGH ISOLATED DMGG WIND GUSTS WILL BE POSSIBLE. HOWEVER...SHOULD MULTIPLE COLD POOLS CONGEAL WITH LOCALIZED AREAS OF UPSCALE CONVECTIVE GROWTH...A GREATER POTENTIAL FOR DMGG WIND GUSTS MAY ENSUE...POTENTIALLY WARRANTING WW ISSUANCE. AS SUCH...THE AREA WILL BE MONITORED FOR THE POSSIBLE ISSUANCE OF A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH THROUGH THE AFTERNOON.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: CONTINUE WWS. WW 386 IS BEING EXTENDED SOMEWHAT NWD ACROSS PORTIONS ERN OH AND WRN PA PER COORD W/WFO PBZ. THOUGH PORTIONS WW 386 ACROSS SWRN PA AND EXTREME NRN WV HAVE BEEN STABILIZED FOR NOW BY PRIMARY TSTM BAND...ADDITIONAL CONVECTION OVER OH MAY POSE AT LEAST MRGL SVR RISK OVER WRN PORTIONS WW AS IT MOVES INTO MODIFYING AIR MASS. MEANWHILE SVR POTENTIAL WILL CONTINUE WITH CONVECTION FROM THERE EWD TO ATLC COAST.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: BAND OF STG-SVR TSTMS ACROSS SWRN PA...GARRETT COUNTY MD AND NERN WV IS MOVING THROUGH RELATIVE MOISTURE MIN ATTM...BUT WILL ENCOUNTER SUBSTANTIALLY RICHER THETAE OVER ERN MTNS AND ADJOINING PIEDMONT. SEVERAL REPORTS OF TOPPLED TREES HAVE BEEN RECEIVED FROM PASSAGE OF THESE TSTMS. FURTHER INTENSIFICATION OF THIS ACTIVITY IS POSSIBLE...AS IS CONTINUED SVR THREAT WITH MORE WIDELY SCATTERED BLEND OF DISCRETE AND CLUSTERED CONVECTIVE MODES FARTHER E TOWARD DE VALLEY AND CHESAPEAKE BAY REGIONS. UPSCALE AGGREGATION OF COLD POOLS IS POSSIBLE FROM ANY OF THIS ACTIVITY...ENHANCING POTENTIAL FOR FORWARD-PROPAGATIONAL DAMAGING WIND ON MESOBETA SCALE. SOME SUPERCELL RISK ALSO EXISTS...PRIMARILY FROM EXTREME SRN PA SWD ACROSS ERN WV PANHANDLE AND MD INTO NRN VA...THEN SHIFTING EWD OVER DELMARVA/NJ. THAT AREA LIES BENEATH ENHANCED BELT OF MID-UPPER LEVEL FLOW THAT OFFSETS VEERED BOUNDARY LAYER WINDS ENOUGH TO GENERATE 40-50 KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR MAGNITUDES. PRECONVECTIVE AIR MASS SHOULD REMAIN FAVORABLY UNSTABLE FOR NEXT FEW HOURS...WITH SFC DEW POINTS 70S F IN LOWER ELEVATIONS AND INSOLATION CONTRIBUTING TO MLCAPE 1500-2500 J/KG E OF BLUE RIDGE. 1000-1500 J/KG MLCAPE IS EVIDENT OVER HIGHER TERRAIN AND WWD INTO ERN OH. ..EDWARDS.. 06/28/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED POTENTIAL FOR SEVERE STORMS MAY DEVELOP THROUGH THE AFTERNOON HOURS...BUT THE ISSUANCE OF A WW IS UNLIKELY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RECENT SFC MESOANALYSIS PLACES A CYCLONE CENTERED APPROXIMATELY 30 NNW COS...WITH A WAVY STATIONARY FRONT EXTENDING NEWD FROM THE CYCLONE CENTER TO NEAR AKO AND THEN INTO NWRN KS. RECENT VIS SATELLITE IMAGES INDICATE CUMULUS BUILDUPS INVOF THE FRONT FROM AKO TO THE CYCLONE CENTER...AND INVOF THE ROCKY MOUNTAIN FRONT RANGE. CONVECTION MAY STRENGTHEN/DEEPEN FROM THIS ACTIVITY DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS. ADDITIONAL CONVECTION MAY DEVELOP FARTHER N AND JUST E OF THE FRONT RANGE OWING TO A MODESTLY MOIST UPSLOPE FLOW REGIME N OF THE CYCLONE/FRONT. THIS REGIME IS CHARACTERIZED BY SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE LOWER/MIDDLE 50S THAT ARC FROM THE LOWER PLAINS INTO NRN PARTS OF THE MCD AREA AMIDST STEEP LOW/MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES SUPPORTING AROUND 500-1500 J/KG OF MLCAPE. DEEP SHEAR WILL BE SUFFICIENTLY STRONG FOR A FEW ORGANIZED STORM STRUCTURES... POTENTIALLY INCLUDING SUPERCELLS...WITH A CONDITIONAL POTENTIAL FOR LARGE HAIL AND SVR WINDS. THE NWLY/NLY MID-LEVEL FLOW COMPONENT WILL HAVE A TENDENCY TO STEER DEVELOPING CONVECTION TOWARD THE DEEPER PBL CIRCULATIONS S OF THE STATIONARY FRONT...WHERE LARGE DCAPE WILL ENHANCE THE CONDITIONAL POTENTIAL FOR SVR SFC WINDS IN PARTS OF E-CNTRL CO. HOWEVER...WEAK DEEP-LAYER ASCENT WILL LIKELY KEEP ANY SVR POTENTIAL ISOLATED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE RISK FOR DMGG WIND GUSTS CONTINUES ACROSS REMAINING VALID PORTIONS OF SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH 385.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SCATTERED TO NUMEROUS CONVECTION ORGANIZED IN MULTICELL CLUSTERS COVERS REMAINING VALID PORTIONS OF WW 385. THE LEADING EDGE OF A STRONGER COLD POOL SURGE IS SUCCEEDED BY A STRATIFORM PRECIPITATION SHIELD AND STABILIZED THERMODYNAMIC PROFILES IN PARTS OF CNTRL AND E-CNTRL AL AND INTO FAR W-CNTRL GA...WHERE THE THREAT FOR SVR STORMS HAS WANED. AREAS MAY BE CLEARED FROM WW 385 FOLLOWING THE INFLUX OF THIS COLD POOL...AS IT MAKES ADDITIONAL SWD/SEWD PROGRESS ACROSS SRN AL AND W-CNTRL GA. IN AREAS WHERE CONVECTIVE OVERTURNING HAS NOT YET BEEN SUBSTANTIAL...MLCAPE VALUES OF 2000-4000 J/KG WILL PROMOTE VIGOROUS UPDRAFTS/DOWNDRAFTS. THE STRENGTH OF DOWNDRAFTS WILL BE AUGMENTED BY STRONG PRECIPITATION LOADING ASSOCIATED WITH PW VALUES OF AROUND 1.7 TO 2.0 INCHES. THE WW WAS EARLIER EXPANDED IN COVERAGE TO INCLUDE ADDITIONAL PARTS OF THE COUNTY WARNING AREAS SERVED BY THE TALLAHASSEE FL AND PEACHTREE CITY GA WEATHER FORECAST OFFICES TO ADDRESS THE POTENTIAL FOR SIMILAR SVR CONVECTION. ..COHEN.. 06/28/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: CONTINUE WW. SVR POTENTIAL REMAINS ACROSS THIS REGION. STG-SVR CONVECTION HAS BECOME ORGANIZED IN DISCONTINUOUS BAND OF QUASI-LINEAR SEGMENTS FROM W-CENTRAL NC NEWD ACROSS S-CENTRAL VA...WITH POTENTIAL FOR DAMAGING GUSTS AND OCNL HAIL. MORE ISOLATED SVR IS POSSIBLE FARTHER SW ACROSS WRN NC AND NWRN SC...HOWEVER TSTMS SHOULD BE MORE WIDELY SCATTERED AND DISORGANIZED WITH SWWD EXTENT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MID-UPPER LEVEL WIND MAX ASSOCIATED WITH SRN RIM OF LOWER GREAT LAKES CYCLONE EVIDENT IN MOISTURE CHANNEL IMAGERY -- WAS EVIDENT FROM IA ACROSS ERN KY...WV AND NRN VA. THIS FEATURE OFFSETS WEAK/VEERED BOUNDARY-LAYER WINDS SUFFICIENTLY TO YIELD FAVORABLE DEEP SHEAR FOR SUPERCELLS...AS HAVE BEEN EVIDENT IN RADAR DATA S AND SE OF DC AREA. STRONGEST ASSOCIATED EFFECTIVE SHEAR VALUES ARE BENEATH THAT SPEED MAX AT 45-55 KT...OVER CENTRAL/NRN VA AND NRN FRINGES OF THIS WW. HOWEVER...DEEP SHEAR FAVORABLE FOR AT LEAST TRANSIENT SUPERCELLULAR FEATURES EXTENDS SWD TO NRN NC. LITTLE CONVECTION IS EVIDENT ATTM IN VIS OR RADAR IMAGERY OVER IMMEDIATE BLUE RIDGE AREA OF W-CENTRAL VA...AND MAY BE PRECLUDED BY WEAK DOWNSLOPING EFFECTS. HOWEVER...THERMODYNAMIC CHARACTERISTICS OF AIR MASS REMAIN FAVORABLE IN THAT AREA WHERE CONVECTION FARTHER E HAS NOT ALREADY PASSED. ANY CONVECTION THAT DOES DEVELOP W OF EXISTING ACTIVITY STILL MAY HAVE FAVORABLE CORRIDOR OF VERTICAL SHEAR AND BUOYANCY WITH WHICH TO BECOME SVR. SFC DEW POINTS 70S F AND TEMPS UPPER 80S TO LOW 90S FOR ANOTHER COUPLE HOURS WILL CONTRIBUTE TO PRECONVECTIVE MLCAPE IN 2000-3000 J/KG RANGE OVER MOST OF WW. ..EDWARDS.. 06/28/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED TO SCATTERED STORMS DEVELOPING ALONG A W-E ORIENTED BOUNDARY FROM SE AR INTO NRN MS MAY POSE A SPORADIC STRONG WIND/HAIL THREAT INTO THE EARLY EVENING. TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED FOR POSSIBLE WW ISSUANCE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STORMS HAVE DEVELOPED THIS AFTERNOON IN A MOIST/STRONGLY UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT ALONG AN OLD OUTFLOW/EFFECTIVE FRONTAL BOUNDARY. THESE STORMS MAY POSE A SPORADIC WIND/HAIL THREAT FOR A FEW HOURS INTO EARLY EVENING GIVEN THE DEGREE OF AVAILABLE INSTABILITY...AND EFFECTIVE SHEAR AROUND 20-25 KT WILL ALLOW FOR SOME WEAK ORGANIZATION IN THE VICINITY OF THE W-E ORIENTED BOUNDARY. HOWEVER...INSTABILITY WEAKENS SOME AND CAPPING APPEARS TO BE SLIGHTLY STRONGER WITH SOUTHWARD EXTENT ACROSS PARTS OF CNTRL MS INTO NE LA. AS STORMS MOVE SWD INTO THIS AREA THEY MAY STRUGGLE TO REMAIN ORGANIZED AND MAY EXHIBIT A MORE PULSE-LIKE NATURE. TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED FOR POSSIBLE WW ISSUANCE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: DAMAGING WIND/LARGE HAIL RISK IS NEAR OR PAST PEAK IN BOTH WATCHES 387 AND 388...WITH THE PRIMARY RISK CONFINED TO AREAS IN NC AHEAD OF THE ONGOING LINE OF STORMS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LOW-LEVEL DRYING/DOWNSLOPE ACROSS WRN NC/VA HAS REDUCED INSTABILITY FROM THE W...WHILE PRIOR CONVECTION HAS STABILIZED AREAS FROM SE PA/NJ INTO NRN MD. FARTHER S...THE AIR MASS IN ADVANCE OF THE NC STORMS REMAINS UNSTABLE WITH SUFFICIENT VERTICAL SHEAR TO MAINTAIN ORGANIZED CELLS/LINE SEGMENTS WITH AN ATTENDANT RISK FOR DAMAGING GUSTS/LARGE HAIL FOR THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS. SURFACE OBSERVATIONS AND VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY SUGGEST THAT ADDITIONAL STRONG/SEVERE THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT IS NOT LIKELY ACROSS CENTRAL VA...BEHIND THE ONGOING BAND OF STORMS. A LOCAL EXTENSION IN AREA OF WW 388 FOR A FEW COUNTIES IN CENTRAL NC MAY BE WARRANTED GIVEN THE PRESENCE OF MODERATE-STRONG INSTABILITY AND STRONG SURFACE HEATING THROUGH THE AFTERNOON IN ADVANCE OF THE ONGOING STORMS. OTHERWISE...THE SEVERE WEATHER RISK APPEARS TO BE DIMINISHING SLOWLY FARTHER TO THE N INTO THE CHESAPEAKE REGION. ..THOMPSON.. 06/28/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SEVERE WEATHER THREAT HAS DIMINISHED AND WW 386 MAY BE CANCELED PRIOR TO THE 00Z EXPIRATION.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: PRIOR CONVECTION HAS COOLED THE BOUNDARY LAYER ACROSS MOST OF THE WATCH AREA AND REDUCED BUOYANCY. WHILE AN ISOLATED STRONG STORM COULD OCCUR IN THE SHORT TERM ACROSS S CENTRAL PA OR SE OH...THE OVERALL DAMAGING WIND/HAIL RISK HAS DIMINISHED TO THE EXTENT THAT A WATCH IS NO LONGER NECESSARY. AS SUCH...REMAINING AREAS OF THE WATCH CAN BE CLEARED PRIOR TO THE SCHEDULED 00Z EXPIRATION.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE TSTM WATCH 385 WILL LIKELY BE ALLOWED TO EXPIRE AT 01Z...BUT A DAMAGING WIND/SOME SEVERE HAIL THREAT MAY CONTINUE SOUTHEASTWARD OUT OF CENTRAL MS/WESTERN AL THIS EVENING SUCH THAT AN ADDITIONAL SEVERE TSTM WATCH MAY BE NEEDED FOR ADDITIONAL PORTIONS OF SOUTHERN MS/SOUTHWEST AL. ADDITIONALLY...ISOLATED SEVERE HAIL MAY REMAIN POSSIBLE ACROSS PORTIONS OF GA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: BULK OF EARLIER QUASI-LINEAR MCS HAS LARGELY DECAYED INTO NORTH FL/FAR SOUTHEAST GA. HOWEVER...ESPECIALLY GIVEN A RESERVOIR OF RELATIVELY STRONG INSTABILITY PER THE 00Z SOUNDING FROM ATLANTA...EPISODIC BOUTS OF SEVERE HAIL CANNOT BE ENTIRELY DISCOUNTED ATOP THE RESIDUAL EASTERN GA COLD POOL /OR TO ITS NORTH/. REGARDLESS...THIS THREAT SHOULD REMAIN RELATIVELY ISOLATED/MARGINAL. MEANWHILE...FARTHER WEST...QUASI-LINEAR CONVECTION CONTINUES TO GRADUALLY ORGANIZE AND OTHERWISE SPREAD SOUTHEASTWARD ACROSS CENTRAL MS/WEST-CENTRAL AL EARLY THIS EVENING. IN CONJUNCTION WITH A RIBBON OF MODERATELY STRONG LOW-MID LEVEL NORTHWESTERLY FLOW /30-35 2-6 KM PER 00Z JACKSON AND BIRMINGHAM SOUNDINGS/...A WEST-SOUTHWESTERLY FEED OF UNSTABLE AIR WILL CONTINUE TO AID STRONG/SEVERE PRIMARILY LINEAR CONVECTION NEAR/WEST OF THE RESIDUAL /BUT SOMEWHAT MODIFYING/ SOUTHERN AL COLD POOL. IN ALL...A NEW WATCH MAY BE NEEDED FOR ADDITIONAL PORTIONS OF SOUTHERN MS/SOUTHWEST AL. ..GUYER.. 06/29/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORMS WILL PERSIST FOR SEVERAL HOURS ALONG OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES...WITH A RISK FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING WINDS/HAIL. HOWEVER...THE NEED FOR A NEW WATCH OR AN EXTENSION IN TIME OF WW 388 IS NOT CLEAR.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THUNDERSTORMS CONTINUE ALONG WHAT HAS BECOME A LARGELY E-W ORIENTED OUTFLOW BOUNDARY ACROSS NC...WHILE OUTFLOW WITH SMALLER CLUSTER ACROSS UPSTATE SC WILL MERGE INTO THE NC OUTFLOW FROM THE SW. MODERATE-STRONG INSTABILITY REMAINS TO THE S-E OF THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES AND ONGOING STORMS...THOUGH BUOYANCY WILL DIMINISH SLOWLY WITH THE LOSS OF DAYTIME HEATING. ALSO...THE NC OUTFLOW HAS SAGGED SWD TO THE SRN FRINGE OF THE STRONGER MIDLEVEL FLOW AND RESULTANT VERTICAL SHEAR. CONSIDERING THESE FACTORS...THE RISK FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING DOWNBURSTS AND MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL WILL PERSIST FOR ANOTHER FEW HOURS ACROSS SRN NC AND ADJACENT AREAS OF SC...THOUGH THE MAGNITUDE OF THE SEVERE THREAT IS MARGINAL AND NEED FOR A NEW WATCH AND/OR EXTENSION OF WW 388 IS NOT CLEAR AT THE MOMENT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED LARGE HAIL/DAMAGING WIND RISK WILL PERSIST FOR ANOTHER 2-3 HOURS...BUT LIMITED AREA/DURATION SUGGEST THAT A WATCH IS NOT NECESSARY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE 00Z DENVER SOUNDING REVEALED STEEP LAPSE RATES THROUGHOUT THE LOW-MID TROPOSPHERE WITH MODEST BUOYANCY. SINCE THE SOUNDING LAUNCH...A SURGE OF COOLER/MOISTER AIR HAS SPREAD SWWD TO THE FRONT RANGE...AND CONTRIBUTED TO THE DEVELOPMENT OF A FEW THUNDERSTORMS IN THE UPSLOPE FLOW REGIME. INITIALLY...THE INCREASE IN LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE /LOW-MID 50S BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS/ WILL BOOST BUOYANCY ALONG THE FRONT RANGE...WHERE MLCAPE HAS REACHED 1000-1500 J/KG. ALSO...THE NELY POST-FRONTAL FLOW IS CONTRIBUTING TO SUFFICIENT DEEP-LAYER VERTICAL SHEAR FOR ORGANIZED/SUPERCELL STRUCTURES. HOWEVER...THE UPCOMING LOSS OF DAYTIME HEATING AND GRADUAL NEAR-SURFACE COOLING WITH COLD AIR ADVECTION FROM THE NE WILL BOTH LEAD TO INCREASING CONVECTIVE INHIBITION BY 03-04Z. THUS...EXPECT THE RISK FOR ISOLATED LARGE HAIL/DAMAGING WINDS TO PERSIST FOR ANOTHER COUPLE OF HOURS AND THEN DIMINISH BY 04Z.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: BROKEN LINE OF STORMS IN MS WILL CONTINUE SEWD...AND MAY PERSIST A TIER OR TWO OF COUNTIES/PARISHES S OF WW 390. HOWEVER...STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO WEAKEN AND A NEW WATCH DOES NOT APPEAR NECESSARY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE BROKEN BAND OF STORMS IN MS CONTINUES TO MOVE SEWD AT ABOUT 25 KT. MODERATE INSTABILITY IS PRESENT S OF THE STORMS...BUT SLOW SURFACE COOLING HAS RESULTED IN A GRADUAL DECREASE IN LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND AN INCREASE IN CONVECTIVE INHIBITION DURING THE PAST 1-2 HOURS. THE LOW-LEVEL STABILIZATION AND RELATIVELY WEAK VERTICAL SHEAR WITH SWD EXTENT BOTH SUGGEST THAT THE STORMS HAVE ALREADY REACHED OR PASSED PEAK INTENSITY AND SHOULD SLOWLY WEAKEN OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. THUS...WHILE CONVECTION COULD MOVE 1-2 TIERS OF COUNTIES/PARISHES TO THE S OF WW 390...THE DAMAGING WIND THREAT SHOULD BE TOO MARGINAL TO WARRANT A NEW WATCH.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SMALL MCS WILL PERSIST FOR THE NEXT FEW HOURS ALONG AND N OF RESIDUAL OUTFLOW. GUSTY OUTFLOW WINDS AND LOCALLY HEAVY RAIN WILL BE POSSIBLE...BUT THE SEVERE THREAT IS NEGLIGIBLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: EARLIER STORMS IN CENTRAL NC HAVE EVOLVED INTO A SMALL MCS ACROSS CENTRAL/E CENTRAL NC. THE CONVECTION APPEARS TO BE FOCUSED IN THE ZONE OF ASCENT IMMEDIATELY N OF A RESIDUAL E-W ORIENTED OUTFLOW BOUNDARY ACROSS E CENTRAL NC...WHERE A FEED OF MODEST INSTABILITY HAS BEEN MAINTAINED ABOVE THE COLD POOL FROM THE S. THOUGH THE RALEIGH VWP SHOWS 40 KT WSWLY MIDLEVEL FLOW...THE MODEST BUOYANCY AND RELATIVELY STABLE LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES N OF THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY SUGGEST THAT THE RISK FOR STRONG/DAMAGING WINDS AT THE GROUND WILL BE LIMITED AT BEST.
